paragraphs: I am a detail-oriented Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable mobile applications using Flutter and React Native.
I specialize in cross-platform mobile apps, Firebase backend systems, REST API integration, payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay), App Store & Play Store deployment, and performance optimization.
I believe in writing clean, scalable, and production-ready code that delivers real business value. Every project I take on is an opportunity to solve meaningful problems through technology.

projects.title: Pearlies
projects.description: Pearlies is a comprehensive healthcare research application developed exclusively for the Faculty of Dentistry at the National University of Singapore (NUS). The app is designed to support early childhood dental care intervention by empowering parents with the right tools, knowledge, and resources to maintain their children's oral health from an early age. It bridges the gap between dental researchers, healthcare professionals, and parents by providing a seamless digital platform for health education, tracking, and engagement. The app follows strict healthcare data privacy standards including PDPA compliance for the Singapore market.
features: Child dental health tracking with progress history and visual charts
Educational content library with articles and instructional videos for parents
Appointment scheduling and intelligent reminder system
Interactive parent-child dental activities and games to build healthy habits
Secure health records management with encrypted data storage
Push notifications for appointment reminders and health tips
Research data collection module for NUS Dentistry faculty
Multi-child profile management for parents with multiple children
projects.role: Served as the primary Flutter developer responsible for architecting and building the complete application from scratch. Implemented the full UI based on designer mockups, integrated REST APIs for data management, set up Firebase for authentication and push notifications, handled Apple App Store and Google Play Store submission including resolving healthcare-specific review guidelines, and ensured PDPA compliance for Singapore market.

projects.title: Boskalis BOSS
projects.description: Boskalis BOSS is an enterprise-grade workforce and project management system developed for Boskalis, one of the world's leading dredging and marine services companies headquartered in the Netherlands. The app is used by field workers and project managers to manage daily job assignments, track real-time work progress, and log accurate working hours across multiple project sites. It eliminates manual paperwork and provides managers with a live digital view of all ongoing field operations. The app was designed to handle multiple simultaneous users updating job statuses in real time, with robust data sync mechanisms to ensure accuracy across all devices.
features: Job assignment dashboard with priority and status indicators
Real-time job status tracking — Pending, In Progress, Completed
Start / Stop / Complete time logging with automatic hour calculation
Working hours summary and daily timesheet generation
Manager dashboard with live field team progress overview
Multi-project support for workers assigned to multiple sites
Push notifications for new job assignments and updates
Offline support with automatic data sync when connectivity resumes
Timezone-aware data handling for Netherlands operations
projects.role: Led the end-to-end development of the workforce management application. Designed the app architecture, implemented real-time job tracking and time logging features, handled complex state management for simultaneous multi-user updates, managed timezone-specific data handling for Netherlands-based client, coordinated directly with international stakeholders for requirement clarification, and handled complete App Store and Play Store deployment.

projects.title: Atesplore
projects.description: Atesplore is the customer-facing application of a dual-app food ordering ecosystem built for the Singapore market. It provides users with a seamless food discovery and ordering experience — from browsing nearby restaurants and exploring menus to placing orders and tracking deliveries in real time. The app is part of a larger ecosystem that includes a separate merchant app, with both apps sharing the same backend infrastructure but serving completely different user journeys. Atesplore focuses on delivering a smooth, intuitive experience for end consumers with secure payment options and real-time order visibility.
features: Location-based restaurant and food discovery
Advanced search and filter by cuisine, price, and rating
Detailed menu browsing with customizable order options
Cart management with real-time price calculation
Secure payment gateway integration
Real-time order tracking with live status updates
Order history and reorder functionality
Push notifications for order confirmation and delivery updates
User profile and saved address management
Ratings and reviews for restaurants and orders
projects.role: Developed the complete customer-facing app including UI implementation, restaurant and menu browsing flow, cart and checkout system, real-time order tracking, payment gateway integration, and push notification setup. Coordinated closely with the backend team for API design and with the merchant app development to ensure seamless ecosystem sync.

projects.title: Atesplore Merchant
projects.description: Atesplore Merchant is the business-facing companion app of the Atesplore food ordering ecosystem. Designed exclusively for restaurant and food outlet owners on the Singapore platform, it gives merchants complete control over their orders, menus, and business performance. When a customer places an order through the Atesplore customer app, the merchant receives an instant notification and can accept, reject, or manage the order in real time. The app provides a comprehensive business dashboard to help merchants monitor sales, track popular items, and optimize their operations.
features: Real-time order notifications with instant accept / reject functionality
Order queue management with status tracking
Complete menu and item management — add, edit, delete items
Category and pricing management
Sales dashboard with daily, weekly, and monthly reports
Popular items and peak hours analytics
Store availability toggle — open / closed status control
Order history with detailed transaction records
Push notifications for every new incoming order
Multi-branch support for merchants with multiple outlets
projects.role: Built the complete merchant-facing application including order management system, real-time notification handling, menu and item management, and sales reporting dashboard. Ensured seamless real-time sync between customer app orders and merchant app notifications using FCM push notifications and API polling.

projects.title: Kimi UAE
projects.description: Kimi UAE is a food ordering and cafe experience application built specifically for the United Arab Emirates market. Designed with UAE consumers in mind, the app provides a seamless cafe and restaurant ordering experience with support for local payment methods and regional user preferences. The app focuses on delivering a premium digital cafe experience, allowing customers to browse menus, customize their orders, make secure payments, and earn loyalty rewards on every purchase. It was developed with localization support to cater to the diverse UAE audience.
features: Restaurant and cafe menu browsing with rich media
Customizable order options — size, extras, special instructions
Cart management with real-time total calculation
Secure payment gateway with UAE local payment support
Real-time order status tracking
Loyalty points earning and redemption system
Order history and favourite items management
Push notifications for order updates and promotional offers
User profile with saved preferences and addresses
Promotional banners and special offer highlights
projects.role: Developed the complete food ordering application for the UAE market including menu browsing, order customization, UAE-specific payment gateway integration, loyalty rewards system implementation, and full App Store and Play Store deployment. Handled localization requirements specific to the UAE market.

projects.title: DreamShop India
projects.description: DreamShop India is a feature-rich e-commerce marketplace application designed for Indian consumers who want a rewarding and engaging online shopping experience. What sets DreamShop apart from typical e-commerce apps is its unique automated rewards system — every time a user completes an order, surprise discount coupons and cashback rewards are automatically added to their account, making every purchase more exciting and encouraging repeat shopping. The app covers a wide range of product categories and is built to handle high traffic with optimized performance and smooth user experience.
features: Product browsing across multiple categories with rich media display
Advanced search with filters — price range, category, ratings
Wishlist and save for later functionality
Cart management with real-time price and discount calculation
Secure checkout with Razorpay payment integration
Automatic surprise rewards and discount coupons after every order
Cashback and loyalty points system
Real-time order tracking with delivery status updates
Order history with invoice and return management
Push notifications for offers, order updates, and new arrivals
User profile with multiple saved delivery addresses
projects.role: Built the complete e-commerce application including product catalog, search and filter, cart and wishlist, checkout flow, Razorpay payment integration, automated rewards and coupon engine, order tracking, and full App Store and Play Store deployment. Optimized app performance for handling large product catalogs and high user traffic.

projects.title: FastFit User
projects.description: FastFit User is the customer-facing application of the FastFit e-commerce platform. It provides users with a smooth and efficient online shopping experience — from product discovery to doorstep delivery. The app is built for speed and performance, ensuring users can browse products, place orders, and track their deliveries without any friction. FastFit operates as a dual-app ecosystem with a separate delivery partner app, ensuring end-to-end order fulfillment management from the customer's tap to the delivery agent's doorstep.
features: Product catalog browsing with categories and search
Advanced filter and sort options
Cart and wishlist management
Secure checkout and payment gateway integration
Real-time delivery tracking with live agent location
Order history and status management
Push notifications for order confirmation and delivery updates
User profile with saved addresses and preferences
Ratings and reviews for products and delivery experience
Promotional offers and discount code management
projects.role: Developed the complete customer-facing application including product catalog, cart and checkout system, order placement, real-time delivery tracking, and payment integration. Coordinated with the backend team and delivery app development to ensure seamless order flow across the ecosystem.

projects.title: FastFit Delivery
projects.description: FastFit Delivery is the delivery partner application of the FastFit e-commerce ecosystem. Built for delivery agents and logistics personnel, the app streamlines the entire delivery workflow — from receiving new order assignments to navigating to pickup and drop locations, updating delivery status, and managing daily earnings. It provides delivery partners with a reliable and efficient tool to manage their work, with real-time navigation integration and clear order management features, ensuring fast and accurate deliveries for end customers.
features: Real-time new order assignment notifications
Order details with pickup and delivery location information
Google Maps navigation integration for pickup and drop
Delivery status management — Accept, Picked Up, On the Way, Delivered
Real-time earnings tracker with daily and weekly summary
Order history with complete delivery records
Push notifications for new order alerts and updates
Availability toggle — online / offline status for agents
Customer contact and communication support
Performance dashboard with delivery stats and ratings
projects.role: Built the complete delivery partner application including order assignment flow, real-time delivery status management, navigation integration, earnings dashboard, and push notification system for new order alerts.

projects.title: SalesPulse
projects.description: SalesPulse is a comprehensive B2B sales operations management application designed to streamline and optimize the end-to-end sales workflow for field sales representatives. From placing new client orders to tracking payment status and monitoring order fulfillment, SalesPulse puts the entire sales process in the palm of a sales rep's hand. The app eliminates manual order-taking processes and gives sales managers real-time visibility into team performance, order pipeline, and revenue tracking — making the sales operation faster, more accurate, and more accountable.
features: New sales order placement with product catalog
Real-time order status tracking — Placed, Processing, Dispatched, Delivered
Customer profile and relationship management
Payment status tracking and collection management
Sales performance dashboard with targets and achievements
Order history with complete transaction records
Push notifications for order updates and approvals
Multi-product order management with quantity and pricing
Sales reports — daily, weekly, and monthly summaries
Offline order placement with automatic sync on connectivity
projects.role: Developed the complete sales management application including order placement flow, real-time order status tracking, customer management, payment tracking, and sales reporting dashboard. Implemented complex business logic for multi-stage order workflows and approval processes.

projects.title: Bajaj MIS
projects.description: Bajaj MIS is an agri-industrial Management Information System application developed for Bajaj Hindustan Ltd, one of India's largest sugar manufacturing companies. The app serves as a real-time digital reporting platform for farmers, field staff, and factory supervisors to monitor cane crushing operations, track cane supply chain movements, and access critical factory performance data. It replaces traditional paper-based reporting with a fast, reliable mobile solution that keeps all stakeholders informed about factory operations in real time.
features: Real-time cane crushing data tracking and reporting
Cane supply chain position monitoring from farm to factory
Factory operation performance dashboard
Farmer portal with individual cane supply records
Payment and account summary for farmers
Field staff reporting and data entry module
Daily, weekly, and seasonal crushing reports
Offline data access with background sync
Multi-factory support for large operations
Alerts and notifications for critical factory updates
projects.role: Developed the complete MIS reporting application including real-time cane crushing data tracking, factory operation reports, farmer and field staff portal, and payment summary features. Implemented data-heavy reporting dashboards with proper pagination and performance optimization for handling large datasets.

projects.title: Dalmia MIS
projects.description: Dalmia MIS is an agri-industrial tracking and reporting application developed for Dalmia Sugar, a leading sugar manufacturing company in India. Used by farmers, salesmen, and factory supervisors, the app provides real-time visibility into cane position within the factory, allowing stakeholders to track exactly where their cane supply stands in the crushing queue. It empowers farmers with transparent, accurate data about their cane movement and payments, while helping factory management monitor supply flow and optimize crushing operations efficiently.
features: Real-time cane position tracking within factory queue
Cane crushing progress and status monitoring
Farmer individual supply and payment records
Salesman performance and target tracking
Factory crushing capacity and throughput reports
Daily supply chain movement reports
Payment account summary and history
Push notifications for cane position updates
Seasonal crushing data analytics
Offline report access for field areas with poor connectivity
projects.role: Built cane position tracking and factory reporting features for Dalmia Sugar's field operations. Implemented complex data visualization for factory queue management and farmer account summaries with real-time API integration.

projects.title: Wave MIS
projects.description: Wave MIS is an agri-industrial tracking application developed for Wave Industries Mills Limited, a sugar manufacturing company in India. The app provides farmers and field staff with real-time access to cane position data, factory crushing reports, and payment summaries — all from their mobile device. By digitizing the traditionally manual reporting process, Wave MIS significantly reduces information delays and gives all stakeholders transparent, accurate, and timely data about factory operations and individual cane supply status.
features: Real-time cane position tracking in factory queue
Factory crushing operations monitoring and reports
Farmer individual cane supply and account records
Salesman field data entry and reporting module
Payment and account summary with transaction history
Daily and seasonal crushing performance reports
Push notifications for important factory updates
Offline data access optimized for poor network areas
Multi-season data support for annual crushing cycles
Simple and intuitive UI designed for non-technical field users
projects.role: Developed cane tracking, factory operation reporting, and farmer account management features for Wave Industries. Focused on building a reliable, data-heavy reporting interface optimized for performance in areas with limited internet connectivity.

projects.title: UK Cane MIS
projects.description: UK Cane MIS is an agri-industrial reporting application developed for UK Cane Society, a cane farming cooperative organization in India. The app provides farmers, field agents, and cooperative managers with real-time access to cane crushing data, factory operation reports, and individual farmer account summaries. It serves as a transparent digital platform that keeps all cooperative members informed about their cane supply status, crushing progress, and payment records — replacing slow, manual paper-based reporting with instant mobile access to critical operational data.
features: Real-time cane crushing data tracking and reporting
Cooperative member farmer portal with individual records
Cane supply position tracking within factory queue
Factory operation performance and capacity reports
Payment account summary and transaction history
Field agent data entry and reporting module
Daily, weekly, and seasonal crushing reports
Offline data access with background sync for field areas
Push notifications for crushing updates and payment alerts
Multi-village and multi-zone support for large cooperatives
projects.role: Developed cane crushing data tracking, cooperative member portal, and factory reporting features for UK Cane Society. Implemented offline-capable reporting for field areas with poor internet connectivity and optimized data loading for large farmer databases.
